name: WayriCAD Variant Manager
description: Preview and manage native KiCad assembly variants with batch operations and verified backups.
description_full: An independent native desktop plugin for comparing assembly states, creating, duplicating, renaming, deleting, bulk editing, merging, swapping and promoting KiCad 10 variants. Shows before/after component tables and saved-board assembly previews. Offline application requires closed project editors and creates a verified backup. Geometry and PCB synchronization remain separate KiCad workflows.
